description: A hospitalization where one medication is started and later stopped, and a home medication's dose is increased, across an admission note and a discharge summary.
input_notes: Hospital admission note: Admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Home medications on admission: Lisinopril 10 mg oral once daily, Atorvastatin 20 mg oral nightly. Starting Ceftriaxone 1 g intravenously once daily for pneumonia treatment.

Discharge summary: Completed IV antibiotic course; transitioning to Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875 mg oral twice daily for 5 more days to complete treatment. Lisinopril increased to 20 mg oral once daily given elevated blood pressures noted during admission. Continue Atorvastatin 20 mg oral nightly.

medications.name: Amoxicillin-clavulanate
medications.notes: for 5 more days to complete treatment

medications.name: Lisinopril
medications.notes: increased from 10 mg due to elevated blood pressures during admission

possible_inconsistencies: Lisinopril dose was increased from 10 mg to 20 mg during the hospitalization.
Ceftriaxone (started on admission) was discontinued and replaced with oral amoxicillin-clavulanate at discharge.
expected.summary: During this hospitalization for pneumonia, IV ceftriaxone was started and later transitioned to oral amoxicillin-clavulanate to complete the course, and lisinopril was increased from 10 mg to 20 mg for elevated blood pressures.
